```mermaid
flowchart TD
    subgraph CloudMCP[Cloud MCP Ecosystem]
        M1[Search MCP Server]

        CG1[Search & Retrieval Cluster]
        CG2[Data Access Cluster]
        CG3[Workflow Cluster]
    end

    subgraph LocalFabric[Unified Local Capability Fabric]
        UI[Single Optimized Interface]
        subgraph Models[Local Foundation Models]
            FM1[Fine-Tuned Model A]
            FM2[Fine-Tuned Model B]
        end
        GOV[Governance Layer]
    end

    AI[Local AI Model Consumer]

    M1 --> CA
    M2 --> CA
    M3 --> CA
    M4 --> CA
    M5 --> CA
    M6 --> CA
    CA --> OD
    OD --> SM
    SM --> CG1
    SM --> CG2
    SM --> CG3
    CG1 --> UI
    CG2 --> UI
    CG3 --> UI
    UI --> FM1
    UI --> FM2
    FM1 --> GOV
    FM2 --> GOV
    GOV --> AI
```

## Sequence Diagram

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant Cloud as Cloud MCP Servers
    participant Ext as Capability Extractor
    participant Overlap as Overlap Detector
    participant Mapper as Semantic Mapper
    participant Engine as Migration Engine
    participant Fabric as Local Capability Fabric
    participant Model as Local Foundation Model
    participant Agent as AI Agent

    Cloud->>Ext: Expose tool capabilities
    Ext->>Ext: Parse schemas and metadata
    Ext->>Overlap: Capability feature vectors
    Overlap->>Overlap: Cluster similar services
    Overlap->>Mapper: Grouped capability clusters
    Mapper->>Mapper: Build unified interface spec
    Mapper->>Engine: Consolidated capability map
    Engine->>Engine: Select base foundation model
    Engine->>Engine: Fine-tune for capability clusters
    Engine->>Fabric: Deploy optimized local models
    Fabric->>Fabric: Register unified API surface
    Agent->>Fabric: Request via single interface
    Fabric->>Model: Route to appropriate model
    Model->>Fabric: Return result
    Fabric->>Agent: Deliver response
```

## Consolidation Process

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    subgraph Before[Before: 1-to-1 Migration]
        R1[Remote Search] --> L1[Local Search]
        R2[Remote Retrieval] --> L2[Local Retrieval]
        R3[Remote Doc Access] --> L3[Local Doc Access]
        R4[Remote SQL] --> L4[Local SQL]
        R5[Remote Issues] --> L5[Local Issues]
    end

    subgraph After[After: Semantic Consolidation]
        R1b[Remote Search] --> SC[Semantic Consolidation]
        R2b[Remote Retrieval] --> SC
        R3b[Remote Doc Access] --> SC
        R4b[Remote SQL] --> SC
        R5b[Remote Issues] --> SC
        SC --> UC1[Unified Search & Retrieval]
        SC --> UC2[Unified Data Access]
        SC --> UC3[Unified Workflow]
    end
```

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    subgraph CapabilityAnalysis[Capability Analysis]
        SCAN[Scan MCP Endpoints]
        EXTRACT[Extract Tool Schemas]
        VECTORIZE[Generate Semantic Vectors]
        CLUSTER[Cluster by Function]
    end

    subgraph MigrationEngine[Migration Engine]
        SELECT[Select Base Model]
        FINE[Fine-Tune per Cluster]
        VALIDATE[Validate Functional Equivalence]
        OPTIMIZE[Optimize Orchestration]
    end

    subgraph Runtime[Runtime Fabric]
        ROUTE[Capability Router]
        EXEC[Model Execution]
        CACHE[Response Cache]
        AUDIT[Audit & Governance]
    end

    SCAN --> EXTRACT
    EXTRACT --> VECTORIZE
    VECTORIZE --> CLUSTER
    CLUSTER --> SELECT
    SELECT --> FINE
    FINE --> VALIDATE
    VALIDATE --> OPTIMIZE
    OPTIMIZE --> ROUTE
    ROUTE --> EXEC
    EXEC --> CACHE
    EXEC --> AUDIT
```

TASK: Create mermaid.js diagrams for this invention. INSTRUCTION: Output ONLY mermaid code blocks. No explanations. MERMAID RULES (for PNG / mermaid-cli compatibility): - Do NOT use HTML line breaks in the diagram: no
,
, or similar anywhere in the mermaid source (including inside node labels). They break many renderers and image export. - Use shorter labels, multiple nodes, or subgraphs instead of forcing line breaks inside one label. INVENTION: --- invention-id: invention-20260701-152015 company: IBM created: 2026-07-01T15:20:16 --- # Invention Idea Instead of recreating every cloud-based MCP server on-prem, the system analyzes the capabilities exposed by all MCP tools and identifies functional overlap between them. Similar services (e.g., search, retrieval, document access, SQL, issue tracking) are folded into a unified capability layer that exposes a single optimized interface to the local AI model. The migration engine then selects or fine-tunes one or more local foundation models capable of servicing these consolidated capabilities, eliminating redundant tools and reducing orchestration overhead. This produces a leaner, faster, and easier-to-govern AI platform while maintaining functional equivalence. The novelty is the semantic consolidation of MCP ecosystems into a unified local capability fabric rather than a one-to-one migration. OUTPUT: ## System Architecture `mermaid flowchart TD subgraph Input[Data Sources] A[Source A] B[Source B] end subgraph Process[Processing] C[Tracker] D[Detector] end subgraph Output[Results] E[Clean Data] F[Alerts] end A --> C B --> C C --> D D --> E D --> F ` ## Sequence Diagram `mermaid sequenceDiagram participant S as Source participant T as Tracker participant D as Detector participant Sys as System S->>T: Submit Data T->>D: Validate D->>Sys: Forward or Block ` Create diagrams specific to THIS invention.
